# netcup_server_snapshot_dryrun (Data Source)

Checks whether a snapshot of a netcup server is possible (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_snapshot_dryrun" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  disk_name = "vda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `disk_name` (String) Disk to snapshot. Needed unless `online_snapshot` is `true`.
- `online_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether to check an online snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `errors` (Attributes List) Errors netcup would give for this snapshot. Empty if the snapshot is possible. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--errors))

<a id="nestedatt--errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `errors`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Code of the error.
- `message` (String) Message of the error.
